title: Finite underlying set models give localized finite module models
statement: Let X be a scheme, B a finite commutative ring, and F an intrinsic B_X-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose that on each site object U the underlying set sheaf of F has finite constant models on an actual covering presieve. Then there is a pro-etale cover of X and finite B-modules M whose localized constant module sheaves are B_X-linear models of F [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf].

source.place: Tag 093S; finite-operation-table refinement and module sheafification, Tag 03CY

proof.text: The small pro-etale precoverage satisfies IsSiteForCoverings: identities and pullbacks exist, its pretopology provides bind transitivity, and stability under base change gives the prescribed pullback covers. Apply the finite-ring-action theorem to F and to the final object.

Its models are restrictions of global constant module sheaves. Restrict the two module presentations to constant scalars. The constant-module sheafification comparison and the constant-sheaf/Over comparison identify these restricted global constants with the localized constant models. Full faithfulness of constant-scalar restriction lifts this isomorphism to intrinsic modules. Compose it with each model; the finite module is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_finiteLocalModels_of_finiteUnderlying
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (F : proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X B))
    (hF : ∀ U : X.ProEt, ∃ S : Presieve U, S ∈ ProEt.precoverage X U ∧
      ∀ (V : X.ProEt) (g : V ⟶ U), S g →
        ∃ Z : Type (u + 1), Finite Z ∧ Nonempty
          ((((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
            (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
              ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F)).over V) ≅
            (constantSheaf ((ProEt.topology X).over V) (Type (u + 1))).obj Z)) :
    IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheafWithModelsOfUniverses.{u, u}
      X B (fun M ↦ Finite M) F
